description: Cancels a Press Room order of this account before anything in it is published: an order queued while it waits for credits, or an order whose items are not yet with the newswire or news site. Reserved credits go back to the balance; nothing is charged. Use this when the person asks in this conversation to cancel that order (confirm: true). Do not use for an item already published or already with the newswire or news site (refused with already_published), or to ask for a refund. Side effects: cancels the order and releases its reserved credits; cannot be undone.

confirm.description: true: the person asked to cancel this order in this conversation. Example: true

order_id.description: The order to cancel, from place_order or get_order_status. Example: "5f0c2a9e-7b1d-4c3e-9a8f-2d6b4e1c7a90"

name: cancel_order
title: Cancel an order
